violations.description: FOOD DISPLAY SERVICE AND TRANSPORT TEMP (5 pts): Butter packets indicating ''refrigeration required'' noted on the counter at room temperature. Also bag of semi frozen egg omlets noted on a rolling cart (must be kept frozen until use). Package label requirements must be handled for safe handling of TCS foods. TCS foods requiring cold storage must be maintained at or below 41?F. TCS foods should not be removed from refrigeration for extended periods and then returned to the cooler or freezer as this can result in temperature abuse and may compromise food safety.

SANITIZATION OF EQUIP. AND UTENSILS (4 pts): An inadequate amount of chlorine sanitizer was noted in the final rinse of the dish machine. This will be re-inspected for correction within 10 days before 10-10-26.

HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): A hand drying device was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory in the kitchen. Paper towels were replaced to correct the violation. | HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): The hand washing lavatory in the kitchen noted being used for other than hand washing. Dirty breakfast dishes noted in hand sink basin. Please train employees that the hand sink must only be used for hand washing.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - DESIGN (1 pts): Cabinets in kitchen room noted not in good repair.
FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Flooring threshold between kitchen and refrigerator area noted in need of repair.

SANITIZATION OF EQUIP. AND UTENSILS (4 pts): An inadequate amount of chlorine sanitizer was noted in the final rinse of the dish machine. Priming of the sanitizer pump was attempted but this did not remedy the problem. Re-inspection for correction of this critical item will occur by 5-14-26. If more time is needed due to service delays the inspector must be contacted to request a delay of re-inspection.

DISHWASHING FACILITIES (2 pts): Sanitizer test strips for the dish machine should be readily accesible for the person working in the kitchen and be used at least daily to ensure that the dish machine is still properly sanitizing dishes. Use of test strips could have possibly prevented todays critical item by alerting the facility to the issue. It is unknown how long the dish machine has not been sanitizing dishes properly.

FOOD DISPLAY SERVICE AND TRANSPORT TEMP (5 pts): Milk noted not being held at 41 degrees fahrenheit or below. Milk in the dispenser must be disposed of and the dispenser taken out of service until it is repaired. A re-inspection for repair of the milk dispenser or correction of critical violation will occur by 12-18-25 unless the inspector is contacted regarding a delay.
